title: cotton sheets
text:
cotton sheets. UPDATE below...Damask white striped cotton sheets... The label says "Egyptian cotton" - but no content - I am assuming 100%. They are also not likely anywhere near 700 count.. they are just too thin. They are made in and shipped from India. The striping is very, very subtle. They washed up well, a bit wrinkly - but real cotton should be and wrinkly sheets are not a thing for me. The lint trap was a giant cotton ball - which, again, you would expect with real cotton sheets. I had just changed my bedding and so I have no put them on my bed yet and fit matters. I will update my review should new info seem useful on that. They are not super soft, but real cotton softens with wear and use, so I am ok with that. Finally, they are NOT a high thread count, pretty thin and lightweight. So they will not last a super long time, but for the money (remember: you get what you pay for), I think they are a reasonable investment in my personal opinion. Hope my pics and review was helpful to you.
UPDATE: 10/1/2019 .... So I just put these on my bed... the pockets are DEEP - as advertised. The fitted bottom stays put, under thick memory foam mattress. I purchased the queen size... the sort of weird part is that the striping goes side ways... not length wise. This is the first time I have ever seen this. Regardless of this surprise, they do work. I have say again, that I do not believe these are 700 count.. they are way too thin. But again, for the price, they will last for a while. I never hesitate to update my reviews -
